name: Casavieja (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and purple, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Casavieja (a ruined house between two trees on white).
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 16 August 1993 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 166 of 30 August 1993); the flag is described as purple, white and green from bottom to top in equal horizontal stripes, with the arms on the central stripe.

features.role: Casavieja arms — ruined house between trees
